name: Version 0.154.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Update skia to m154 by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1307

name: Version 0.152.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Expose `Canvas.drawAnnotation` by @MatkovIvan in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1253
* Update emscripten docker ubuntu version by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1254
* Make window resizing smooth on Windows with Direct3D by @m-sasha in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1243
* Eliminate background flash on first window show by @m-sasha in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1237
* Fix `no window flash on first show` test and disable it where it doesn't work by @m-sasha in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1258
* AWT: collapse the per-backend render stack by @MatkovIvan in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1234
* Update Skia to m152 by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1255
* Fix `equals`, `hashCode` and `copy` of `SkiaLayerProperties` by @m-sasha in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1264
* Dispose metal surface immediately after submitting by @m-sasha in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1265
* [web] Extract wasm-opt phase to a separate step by @nopjar in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1247
* Refactor FontMgrDefaultFactory and introduce dedicated tests by @Schahen in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1263
* Support resizing of Web SkiaLayer and CanvasRenderer by @eymar in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1256
* Minor bug fixes by @ApoloApps in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1269
* Move GLTexture.wasm.kt to webMain by @eymar in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1270
* Add Matrix* tests by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1271
* feat: add gradle task to automatically download emscripten by @nopjar in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1251
* Return null from `ColorFilter.makeBlend` for no-op blends by @MatkovIvan in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1272
* Fix Linux system theme detection returning unknown by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1276
* Add Graphite Vulkan by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1261
* Add skiko-graphite-awt to CI release by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1277
* Load/parse `SkikoProperties` lazily instead of on every access by @m-sasha in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1280
* Use `delay(Duration)` overload by @m-sasha in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1279
* Make `Version` resolve in IDEA by @m-sasha in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1281
* Fix Metal live resize when `skiko.buffering=DOUBLE` by @m-sasha in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1283
* AWT frame-driving extraction by @MatkovIvan in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1273
* Remove stubs.cc by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1285
* Increase wasm stack size to 1 MB by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1288
* Migrate on new skiko runtime publication by @terrakok in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1290
* [web] Enforce exact list of proposals enabled in skiko.wasm artifact by @Schahen in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1291
* Fix composite build for skiko samples. by @terrakok in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1295
* Add --debuginfo to preserve function names for skiko.wasm profiling binary by @eymar in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1296
* Introduce SkiaLayer.makeWithContextAttributes to pass arbitrary EmscriptenWebGLContextAttributes by @eymar in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1284
* Decouple AWT redrawers from Ganesh object creation by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1266
* Fold the macOS context handlers into their redrawers by @MatkovIvan in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1287
* Remove redundant inLiveResize property by @m-sasha in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1297
* Direct3D. Fix adapter probing with DirectX 11 instead of 12 by @igordmn in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1298

## New Contributors
* @nopjar made their first contribution in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1247

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/compare/v0.151.0...v0.152.0

name: Version 0.151.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Setup runtime fat jar publication by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1222
* Remove extra `layer.inDrawScope` call in AngleRedrawer.kt by @m-sasha in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1225
* Apply `RenderNode.alpha` during draw by @MatkovIvan in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1227
* Convert non-enum classes to value classes to avoid allocations by @ApoloApps in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1209
* Reduce binary size using dead-code stripping compile/link flags for windows, linux and android by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1228
* Remove dead `FontMetrics` JNI interop referencing a removed constructor by @MatkovIvan in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1230
* Use skia m151-a2e1c9eee0 by @MatkovIvan in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1229
* Pass flag for pre-release publishing by @MatkovIvan in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1231
* Do not require `brew` binary in `PATH` during `:skiko:patchSkikoSymbolsIosArm64` by @MatkovIvan in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1232
* Wasm texture adoption by @serjsysoev in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1219
* Refactor Skiko Web Runtime publication by @terrakok in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1233
* Avoid JNI calls inside primitive array critical regions by @EarzuChan in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1235
* Extract skottie into separate module by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1213
* Configure Dokka for multi-module documentation by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1236
* Make window resizing smooth on macOS with Metal by @m-sasha in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1226
* Provide alias for skikoWasm memory buffer by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1238
* Use maven cache redirector in skottie by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1239
* Suppress `WEBGL_debug_renderer_info` and `non-portable extension enabled: WEBGL_polygon_mode` warnings in WebGL contexts by @terrakok in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1240
* Suppress `READ_BUFFER` and `multisampled attachment` warnings in WebGL contexts by @terrakok in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1241
* Pre-cache SkPicture snapshots for RenderNode by @MatkovIvan in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1022
* Update skia to m151-95f46ce146 by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1244
* Update skia to m151-ab72428249 by @MatkovIvan in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1246
* Move checksum task registration and publishing task grouping to buildSrc by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1249
* Run iOS simulator arm64 tests with Metal in CI by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1248
* Fix RenderNode static assertion constexpr compatibility by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1250
* Add graphite module by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1245
* Fix graphite publishing by @hub-bla in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1252

## New Contributors
* @serjsysoev made their first contribution in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1219
* @EarzuChan made their first contribution in https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/pull/1235

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/JetBrains/skiko/compare/v0.150.1...v0.151.0
